label: Foot Bridge
literalRoomDescription: You are standing on a crude but sturdy wooden foot bridge crossing a deep ravine. The path runs north and south from here.
safeSceneProfile: On a crude but sturdy wooden foot bridge crossing the deep ravine inside the cavern. The path runs north and south. NORTH returns to Narrow Tunnel; SOUTH leads to Great Cavern. DOWN is a fatal-drop refusal, and CROSS is a request to specify a direction, not a third route. Keep the bridge deck in its separate source BRIDGE asset; do not duplicate it in the static shell. No daylight, added doors, collectible planks or invented collapse state. Moss-lit cavern ambience is an art continuation of the adjacent cavern; source room lighting remains authoritative.
